_comment: Static reference geography. Not live data: a station does not move.
Provenance: the coordinates are the ones that were written into
frontend/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx and NetworkMap.jsx. That was the
only station geography in this repository, and the two copies disagreed
about Vadodara (NetworkMap only) and about trailing zeroes. This file is
the union, which is why it had 13 stations and not 12.
Seven more were added later: the stations the seeded trains report as
their current station but that this file had no coordinate for, which
left 7 of 12 trains off the map. Their lat/lng were looked up against
OpenStreetMap via Nominatim and each is recorded with the OSM object it
came from in docs/UNIFY_PROGRESS.md. Their `zone` values are NOT from
that lookup -- they are the standard Indian Railways zone codes,
asserted, and nothing reads the field.
The `name` must stay exactly as written: the train-to-coordinate join
is by station name, so changing "Thiruvananthapuram" to
"Thiruvananthapuram Central" would silently unmap that train again.
The corridors are NetworkMap's four named ones, rewritten as station codes
so the coordinates exist in exactly one place. Dashboard's three unnamed
polylines were variants of the same three routes and carried no id.
